recentTasks.title: EC2 Auto-Termination Fix - IMDSv2 Authentication
recentTasks.summary: Fixed EC2 instances not auto-terminating after idle timeout. Root cause: IMDSv2 requires two-step authentication (session token via PUT request, then instance ID fetch with token header). Implemented proper IMDSv2 support in getInstanceId() function. Instances now terminate after 5 minutes idle, saving costs.
